newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower, seen stable.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended weaker against the U.S. dollar on Saturday on continued concerns over likely outflows of foreign equity funds, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.498, against Friday's T$27.491 finish. Turnover was US$74 million.
Some foreign funds started to take profits in the stock market and repatriate U.S. dollars as the year-end bookclosing period neared, pushing the the Taiwan dollar down, dealers said.
"But the central bank's intention to keep the Taiwan dollar stable should limit any major movements," said a dealer. A T$27.47-53 range was seen for next week. --Joyce Liu (5080815)
